stills.label: Still A: reg-constr-40m.png

puck.evidence: Not visible anywhere on the rink surface or near any skater's stick.

carrier.evidence: Not visible because the puck is entirely absent, making carrier identification impossible.

team_colours.evidence: The two teams are instantly distinguishable by their vibrant cyan blue and warm orange cylindrical figures.

far_net.evidence: Located at the far center boards, visible as a distinct red rectangular goal frame roughly 90 pixels wide directly under the vertical light pillar.

zone_strips.evidence: The dark blue zone lines and dark red center red line are high-contrast, multi-pixel thick horizontal bands spanning the entire width of the ice.

stills.first_look: The massive blown-out white spotlight pool on the lower half of the rink
noise: Overblown white spotlight pools washing out the ice surface texture
Bright white studio spotlights mounted on tripods outside the boards
Yellow-and-white camera crane and film set props in the dark background
Vertical white light pillar rising from the far goal frame

stills.label: Still B: large-constr-40m.png

puck.evidence: Not visible anywhere on the ice surface or around any of the player models.

carrier.evidence: Not visible as no puck or indicator exists to determine possession.

team_colours.evidence: Easily told apart by the saturated light blue and bright orange jersey hulls.

far_net.evidence: Visible at the far end center boards as a clean red rectangular frame topped by a bright vertical beam.

zone_strips.evidence: The blue defensive/offensive zone lines and red center line clearly stripe across the rink in high contrast.

stills.first_look: Blinding overexposed white glare dominating the foreground ice
noise: Extreme overexposure in the foreground spotlight washing out rink details
Film crane, spotlight rigs, and clapperboard outside the boards
High-intensity vertical beacon beam centered above the far net
Perimeter floor lamps casting extraneous halos outside the rink
